title: Committed Choice with committed_alt
description: Define ParseError and committed_alt(primary_p, fallback_p, commit_p) so a matched prefix commits to primary_p and raises an error on failure instead of backtracking.

steps.description: Define the custom ParseError(msg, pos) exception class that records the error message and input position pos.

In committed_alt(primary_p, fallback_p, commit_p), test commit_p(s, pos) first: if it matches, run primary_p(s, pos) and raise ParseError if primary_p returns None; otherwise fall back to fallback_p(s, pos).

steps.question: If commit_p(s, pos) succeeds at pos, will committed_alt ever try fallback_p(s, pos) if primary_p fails?
steps.answer: No; once commit_p matches, line 18 raises ParseError immediately when primary_p returns None instead of falling through to line 21.

steps.description: Print confirmation that committed_alt is defined.
Inspect the environment after ParseError and committed_alt are defined.
